query: INSERT INTO businesses.business_name (business_id, business_name, trade_name, city_license_number, changed_at) SELECT id, $2, $3, $4, now() FROM businesses.business WHERE id = $1 ON CONFLICT (business_id) DO UPDATE SET business_name = EXCLUDED.business_name, trade_name = EXCLUDED.trade_name, city_license_number = EXCLUDED.city_license_number, changed_at = EXCLUDED.changed_at
